title: Human oversight key to successful agent-driven development (Stripe Minions EN)
voice_notes: EN twin of HE Minions post; WHAT in message / HOW in system; CTO tester quote; closes with requirement authorship question.
body_excerpt: Every dev manager I talk to tells me the same thing: Claude and GPT are doing amazing work for the team. ... Who writes the requirement in your team, and how do you know it's right?
